store.0: User Michael, 35, from Seattle. Freelance designer. Ordered espresso machine. Damaged: box, dent, bent steam wand, misaligned reservoir. Full replacement. Cross-ship, no return. Free. Due to a delayed delivery, he is now considering alternatives such as a standard drip coffee maker or visiting a local coffee shop for morning brews. He seeks a quick, practical solution to maintain the event's excitement without compromising on coffee quality.
store.1: Michael(Seattle) reports damaged stainless-steel espresso machine: outer box has seven crushed corners and caved-in top, indicating severe handling issues. Upon opening, significant dent on the right side of the machine's stainless-steel body with inward deformation and sharp edges, suggesting direct impact. Water reservoir area is slightly misaligned, hinge does not close flush—raises concerns about potential leaks or electrical issues. The frothing pitcher(in separate small box) has a minor external scratch but is otherwise intact. Full replacement requested due to structural, functional, and safety-related damage.
